summary: Knights of Honor entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Knights of Honor

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG Knights of Honor release
primary.why: Knights of Honor is a PC grand-strategy game and the modern Steam/GOG releases are the practical route for capture and compatibility. There is no sourced console branch.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows PC release. Record storefront, patch/version, resolution/UI scaling, kingdom, difficulty, campaign state, mods, autosave/manual save use, and whether original disc behavior was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving original retail behavior.
secondary.why: Modern PC storefront releases are easier to run and capture.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Knights of Honor II: Sovereign; record version and mod state.
